scope: Offline travel retrieval development diagnostic; no generation or deployment
holdout_policy: Never open or rescore the previously used H holdout. A/B are development evidence only. A new independent reviewed holdout is required before adoption.
corpus: Existing 130 travel-only policy chunks; original source IDs and text preserved
encoder: Existing bge-m3:latest 1024-dimensional cached vectors; artifact SHA pinned at execution, original model revision unavailable
evidence_requirement: h1 is exact single-evidence fallback control; h2 is an assumed workload sensitivity diagnostic, not inferred from gold and not a deployed estimator. Alternative gold IDs must not be counted as independent evidence requirements.
failures: Cache missing or schema error stops execution explicitly; no network, no silent omitted question, no old artifact overwrite
